messages:
tara: Quick flag  after routing tweak v3 we rolled yesterday: endpoint /v1/complete shows p95 +110ms but p99 -150ms on the endpoint dashboard. The UI is showing merged percentiles only, so this smells like a mixed-route effect. Anyone else see this pattern?

leo: Yep. That pattern usually means a small route moved some midtail mass around. Merged tdigest summaries can make p99 look better while p95 worsens if the clusters separate.

nina: I'll run a per-route compare. Also will check tokenization buckets; longer inputs often amplify midtail.

metrics-bot: Job 110045 submitted by nina: per-route-quantiles (/v1/complete) over 60m. ETA ~20s.

nina: quick numbers: main-route: p50 60ms p95 180ms p99 920ms cnt 29,400; fallback-route: p50 130ms p95 330ms p99 410ms cnt 4,100; merged tdigest p95 210ms merged exact (sampled) p95 185ms. fallback fraction ~12%.

sre-oncall: those counts matter for autoscaling. If fallback fraction jumps we might need different thresholds. Also: header X-Route-Used exists but I think our edge rewrites strip it for some mobile clients.

janet (console): UX notes: (a) endpoint page only shows merged quantiles by default; (b) no provenance indicator on the sparkline; (c) hover tooltip shows only merged numbers. We should: add a routes small badge on the sparkline, expand hover to show per-route p50/p95/p99 with counts, and display "approx" badge when using tdigest.

leo: Operationally I'd like an auto-banner when fallback_fraction > 5%: "Mixed routing detected (Y% fallback). Drill into per-route view." Short yellow banner under the endpoint name would be enough.

nina: +1. Also propose an API/ingest flag prefer_exact_quantiles=true that the console can set for on-demand queries (costly but useful for rollouts). We can keep merged tdigest for the default cheap view.

metrics-bot: Note: prefer_exact_quantiles requires fetching raw samples and costs ~4x.

tara: For rollouts, PMs keep scanning p99 only and will approve if p99 looks fine. We should change rollout default comparator to per-route p95 (or at least show both merged and per-route deltas side-by-side).

janet (console): I'll draft a tiny spec: 1) routes badge + hover expansion, 2) auto-banner when fallback_fraction>5% OR bimodal_flag=true, 3) toggle to request prefer_exact_quantiles for the current time window. I'll attach mockups.

leo: Regarding detection, nina can compute a simple diptest or Gaussian-mixture separation score per-endpoint over 15m windows and emit bimodal_flag when score>0.3. UI can rely on that.

nina: I can add a job. Suggested query snippet:

```
-- per-endpoint dip test over 15m
SELECT endpoint, diptest(latency_ms) AS dip, count(*) AS cnt
FROM telemetry.ingress
WHERE ts BETWEEN now()-interval '15 minutes' AND now() AND endpoint='/v1/complete'
GROUP BY endpoint
HAVING count(*)>500;
```

sre-oncall: Also can we ensure X-Route-Used header survives the gateway? I'll open a tracer for a few mobile flows. If header missing, backfills won't attribute routes properly.

metrics-bot: Job 110045 completed in 19s. Results posted to ticket #ENG-5962.

tara: Action items: nina -> add diptest job + post threshold proposal; janet -> spec UI badge/banner/toggle; leo -> prototype banner & add rollout note to runbook; sre-oncall -> verify X-Route-Used preservation. I'll create tasks in the eng-platform board.

janet (console): tiny UX quibble: when we show per-route numbers, include a small chart legend: main vs fallback colors, and show sample counts inline. PMs prefer seeing counts next to percentiles.

tara: Also add rollout runbook line: "If fallback_fraction > 3% or bimodal_flag=true, reject rollout until per-route p50/p95 checked."

leo: OK thanks. If we get the banner + toggle quickly it should reduce confusion in the next canary.

tara: Thanks team. tagging @product and @sre for visibility. :thumbsup:
